# Synthetic fixtures

small.json: 3 findings, 6 images. bounds.json: 20 findings, 30 images. Both follow the jointly reviewed v1 schema shape; hashes and encoded file sizes are in manifest.json. Images are generated by the self-contained generate.py using Pillow, synthetic terminal/grid content and reserved .test hosts only. No external or confidential inputs.

Coverage: PNG/JPEG, portrait/landscape/tall, 650-character request token, XML-special text, Unicode, blank optional impact. Default tall mode fit; browser tests clone tall images with tallMode split to exercise contiguous crops. Each screenshot has an explicit END marker for visual checking. These fixtures hit finding/image count bounds, not the 25 MiB byte boundary. Byte/pixel-limit rejection is a separate validator test.

Regeneration: run `python tests/fixtures/generate.py` with Pillow installed. It creates only the two JSON fixtures and manifest; no external image inputs. Consolas on Windows is preferred; a different fallback font changes image hashes. This helper is a development tool; it is not part of the app.
